rules.prepare:
# As in Debian: curl is built twice, each time from a copy of the sources. # Debian's patches make the library of the GnuTLS build libcurl-gnutls. for TLS in openssl gnutls; do cp -a "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$TLS"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$TLS" autoreconf -vfi bh_autotools_dev_update
# The options of Debian's rules, but these are not there: LDAP, GSSAPI, # libssh2, HTTP/3. PKG_CONFIG="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" \ ./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-dependency-tracking \ --disable-ldap \ --disable-ldaps \ --disable-silent-rules \ --enable-static \ --enable-symbol-hiding \ --enable-threaded-resolver \ --enable-versioned-symbols \ --with-brotli \ --with-ca-bundle=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \ --with-ca-path=/etc/ssl/certs \ --with-libidn2 \ --with-libpsl \ --with-nghttp2 \ --with-zstd \ --without-gssapi \ --without-libssh \ --without-libssh2 \ --without-nghttp3 \ --without-ngtcp2 \ --with-"$TLS" done
rules.build: for TLS in openssl gnutls; do make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" -C "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$TLS" done
rules.install:
for TLS in openssl gnutls; do make -C "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$TLS" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$TLS" install
sed -i "s@-ffile-prefix-map=[^ \"']* *@@g" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$TLS/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/curl-config"
install -D -m 644 "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$TLS/docs/libcurl/libcurl.m4" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$TLS/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/aclocal/libcurl.m4" done
# As in Debian. cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/gnutls/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" ln -s libcurl-gnutls.so libcurl.so ln -s libcurl-gnutls.a libcurl.a
